description: News photograph of Chinese President Xi Jinping and then-Vice President Joe Biden raising glasses in a toast at a formal indoor event. A U.S. flag and a lectern bearing a Department of State-style seal are visible behind Biden, consistent with the September 2015 State Department luncheon honoring Xi's state visit to Washington.
flags: Event/date inferred from setting (2015 State Department luncheon), not shown in the image

description: Screenshot of Q drop #4171 (May 9 2020) as rendered on a Q aggregator site. The drop contrasts the length of China's COVID-19 lockdowns with U.S. lockdowns, links a China Briefing article about the extended Lunar New Year holiday, and questions why the rest of China locked down for only 16 days while forecasting continued U.S. state lockdowns. The drop's claims are the drop's own assertions.
text: Q !!Hs1Jq13jV6 ID: b2e4dd No.9091582. 4171. May 9 2020 03:53:07 (EST) NEW. Origin Country of COVID-19: China. Origin City of COVID-19: Wuhan. How long was Wuhan on lockdown: 76 days. How long was the remainder of China on lockdown:. CNY extend Jan 24 - Feb 9 (avg): 16 days. https://www.china-briefing.com/news/china-extends-lunar-new-year-holiday-february-2-shanghai-february-9-contain-coronavirus-outbreak/. How long has the US been on lockdown?. No spread of COVID-19 outside of Wuhan?. How is it possible the source Country of the virus (minus Wuhan) was on lockdown for only 16 days?. How long has the US been on lockdown?. Forecasted lockdown CA, NY, OR, MI, ......?. Reconcile. Logical thinking. Q
flags: Drop's claims about lockdown durations and virus spread are unverified assertions of the Q post itself

description: Screenshot of Q drop #1332 (May 10 2018) as rendered on a Q aggregator site. The drop addresses 'Fellow Patriots,' claims forthcoming information will show criminal and corrupt abuse of power by 'the Hussein administration' (the drops' term for the Obama administration) with domestic and foreign dignitaries, links a YouTube video, and closes with movement slogans including WWG1WGA. The drop's allegations are its own unverified claims.
text: Q !4pRcUA0lBE 74 NEW. May 10 2018 21:43:20 (EST). 1332. Fellow Patriots:. What you are about to learn should not only scare you, but intensify your resolve to take back control [Freedom]. The information that will become public will further demonstrate the criminal & corrupt [pure evil] abuse of power that the Hussein administration undertook in joint efforts w/ domestic and foreign dignitaries. The snowball has begun rolling - there is no stopping it now. D5. Stay the course and trust the plan. Protective measures are in place. Remain BRAVE. We knew this day would come. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G2qIXXafxCQ. United We Stand (WW). WWG1WGA. We FIGHT. Conspiracy no more. Q
flags: 'Hussein administration' is the drop's reference to Barack Obama; the corruption allegations are unverified claims of the Q post itself

description: Screenshot (dark mode) of a tweet by the anonymous legal commentary account Techno Fog (@Techno_Fog), posted 4 minutes before capture. The tweet claims the initial leak of the Michael Flynn / Sergey Kislyak call was made not to columnist David Ignatius but to Washington Post reporter Adam Entous, quoting that the leak came from sources who saw a transcript and described it to Entous.
text: Techno Fog @Techno_Fog · 4m. Developing.... The INITIAL Flynn/Kislyak leak was not to David Ignatius – it was to WaPo reporter Adam Entous. The leak came directly from “sources [who] saw a transcript and described it to [Entous].”
flags: Techno Fog is an anonymous account; the tweet's claim about the leak's recipient is the account's assertion, not verified

description: Fan-made movie-poster-style graphic reading 'PANIC IN DC' in red and white block letters, echoing the recurring Q-drop phrase. The background is styled as a redacted TOP SECRET//NOFORN document with FOIA-style exemption codes (b1, b3, b7A, b7E) in the margins, overlaid on a Washington D.C. skyline silhouette showing the Capitol dome, Washington Monument, Lincoln Memorial and White House. Tagline quotes 'They never thought she would lose' attributed to Q, with 'IN THEATERS NOW' at the bottom.
text: TOP SECRET//NOFORN. “THEY NEVER THOUGHT SHE WOULD LOSE” -Q. PANIC. b1-. b3-. b7A. b7D. b7E. IN DC. b7A-. TOP SECRET//NOFORN. IN THEATERS NOW
terms: they never thought she would lose
flags: 'She' in the tagline refers implicitly to Hillary Clinton losing the 2016 election; the poster is a fictional promotional-style meme, not a real film
